profile.headline: Software Development Engineer II at Yardi
profile.summary:
Experienced Software Engineer with a speciality in the JavaScript/TypeScript ecosystem. Whether it's React, Vue, Svelte, or Vanilla JS, I love to build intuitive user interfaces. Along with a strong understanding of the frontend. I'm also well vetted to develop backends as well. From building RESTful and idempotent APIs to designing normalized databases.

During my startup experience, I've collaborated with UX/UI designers and product managers to build user focused solutions. Plus, mentoring junior developers in following best practices for Vue.js and Laravel.

I’m passionate about staying ahead of industry trends and exploring new tools and best practices to deliver high-quality software. I aim to leverage my full-stack development expertise to lead engineering teams in building innovative web applications.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
· Led the front end design and development of a calendar based scheduling feature that produced feature adoption from 100+ organizations.

· Utilized emerging technologies such as OpenAI's text embedding models to play a key role in a network-wide venue audit, resulting in achieving Vistar Accelerate Certification.

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description:
· Developed and implemented Atmosphere Playlists, contributing to a significant increase in viewership by approximately 30% across a network of over 60,000 venues.

· Upgraded customer portal from Vue 2 to Vue 3, enhancing developer workflow. Redesigned dashboard to display essential user metrics, improving user experience.
